summary: Atlassian filed an 8-K for routine quarterly results (Item 2.02) and disclosed that CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes will establish a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan for open-market purchases of up to $250 million of Class A common stock (Item 8.01). The plan involves no company repurchase, no premium, no board recommendation, and no structural or regulatory implications beyond standard cooling-off and Form 4 disclosures. This is not a special situation; it is an executive's personal trading plan, not a capital return program or management change. No deal terms apply.
